Remove to withdraw funds from the Pool Click on Remove to withdraw your funds to your Spot Wallet. At any time, you can remove your funds from the pool according to your current pool share. The removal can be proportional to the two cryptos of the pair selected, or you can pick one of the cryptos individually. If you choose one crypto, you will have to pay a transaction fee which will be deducted from the amount you can get. Lets see how to trade cryptos with a single swap Click on the Swap section, select the crypto asset you want to sell or buy.
